The Platform2024 and Realm2024 structs correspond to the 
platform and realm tokens specified in 
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ffm-rats-cca-token-03.

## Generation of CBOR tokens

The CBOR tokens in this folder were generated by running the
following command from the root of the evcli(https://github.com/veraison/evcli) 
repository, with this folder copied to the root:
```shell
go run . cca create \
  --claims=token-2024/cca-claims-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.json \
  --iak=token-2024/ec256.json \
  --rak=token-2024/ec384.json \
  --token=token-2024/cca-token-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.cbor \
```

This should work once evcli is updated to the next version after v2.2:
```shell
evcli cca create \
  --claims=token-2024/cca-claims-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.json \
  --iak=token-2024/ec256.json \
  --rak=token-2024/ec384.json \
  --token=token-2024/cca-token-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.cbor \
```

## ccatoken golden, appraise and verify

The reference value and trust anchor files were generated with the following command:
```shell
ccatoken golden \
  -e cca-token-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.cbor \
  -c ec256-pub.json \
  -t ta-ffm-03.json \
  -r rv-ffm-03.json
```

If the command is run on the mandatory-claims-only token, identical trust anchor and 
reference value files are generated.
 - The trust anchor is expected to be the same, as both tokens were signed with the same
 CPAK, ec256.json. (Note: IAK is a legacy name for CPAK.)
 - The reference values are the same for now, as this repo's store module has not yet
 been updated to include the new claims added in draft-ffm-03.


Command and expected output for appraisal with reference values:
```shell
ccatoken appraise -e cca-token-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.cbor -r rv-ffm-03.json
```

```
appraisal completed
platform trust vector: {
  "instance-identity": 2,
  "configuration": 2,
  "executables": 3,
  "hardware": 2,
  "runtime-opaque": 32
}
realm trust vector: {
  "executables": 2
}
```

Command and expected output for verification with trust anchor:
```shell
ccatoken verify -e cca-token-draft-ffm-03-all-claims.cbor -t ta-ffm-03.json
```

```
verification completed
platform trust vector: {
  "instance-identity": 2
}
realm trust vector: {
  "instance-identity": 2
}
```
